candidates.change_summary: Changed proxiableUUID to return the ADMIN_SLOT constant instead of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Changed proxiableUUID to return the BEACON_SLOT constant instead of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Changed proxiableUUID to return a hardcoded fake bytes32 value.
Removed the delegation check entirely so proxiableUUID always proceeds without revert.
Delete the call to __UUPSUpgradeable_init() so the UUPS upgradeable state is not initialized.
Delete the call to __Access_init(_accessControl) so the access control state is not initialized.
Delete the entire modifier body except the underscore so that the initializer guard is completely bypassed.
Replace the line setting $._initialized = 1 with an immediate revert so that initialize always fails.
Change the condition on the validity check to always revert by replacing it with true.
Change the elapsed != block.timestamp check to always false, forcing utilization to always come from IVault(_vault).utilization(_asset).
Delete the line that updates utilizationData.index, so future elapsed-based calculations use a stale index.
Delete the line that updates utilizationData.lastUpdate, so subsequent calls always re-enter the timestamp branch.
Use assignment by reference for utilizationData only once, removing the mutation of the storage pointer's fields inside the branch so that reads after the branch see unchanged values.
